current.bodyMarkdown:
## 🚨 GPT-Voyager 1.8.2 — 紧急修复：公式复制

ChatGPT 前几天改了数学公式的渲染方式（不再输出隐藏的 LaTeX 源码），导致**三条公式复制路径同时失效**：

- 点击公式没有任何反应；
- 鼠标划选后 Ctrl+C，复制到的是渲染出来的符号而不是 LaTeX；
- 用 ChatGPT 自带的「复制」按钮，公式的定界符也修不回来了。

**1.8.2 已全部修复**，并且改成同一套取源逻辑 + 一层兜底：即使 ChatGPT 以后再改属性名，只要源码还在页面里就仍然能复制。

另外还修了：「移动到文件夹」菜单项在当前 ChatGPT 上完全不出现，以及该弹窗每行多出来的紫色 "folder" 字样（感谢 @isolature 反馈 #7）。


**🧮 顺带**：新增「Desmos / 计算器」复制格式。Desmos 这类输入框只要遇到一个不认识的命令就会把**整条粘贴丢掉**，而 ChatGPT 的公式里满是 `displaystyle` `qquad` ` oxed{}` 这种纯排版命令（`,` 甚至会被粘成一个逗号）。新格式会把这些去掉，复制完可以直接粘进 Desmos。在扩展弹窗的「公式复制格式」里选。

**📦 现在就要用**：到 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases/tag/v1.8.2) 下载 1.8.2。

**🏬 商店版**：最近 Chrome / Edge 商店审核速度很快，一般几个小时就能通过（不再是以前的三天）。所以如果你当初是因为等审核太久才换成 GitHub 版、又懒得每次手动更新，现在完全可以装回商店版，之后自动更新即可。

## 中文 — 常用功能

- **Folder 文件夹**：在侧边栏本地整理对话，支持整区和搜索框收起、文件夹展开、`f:` 仅搜索文件夹、手动或最近打开排序、拖动、嵌套文件夹，以及 JSON 导入导出。
- **时间线 (Timeline)**：右侧圆点对应每轮对话；悬浮查看预览，点击快速跳转，并随新消息实时更新。
- **图钉与收藏**：在长回答中钉住具体位置，或收藏消息并跨对话返回。
- **回复完成通知**：发送消息后即使切换对话或浏览器标签页，也能在回复完成时收到系统通知，点击返回原对话。
- **长代码块折叠**：按需折叠和展开长代码，不影响短代码块或 Mermaid 图表。
- **聊天排版**：调整聊天字号、行高、段落间距和内容宽度。
- **导出对话**：导出完整对话或选择部分消息，支持 Markdown、JSON 和 HTML。
- **Prompt Manager**：保存、搜索和分类提示词，支持复制或插入输入框。
- **输入增强**：输入框折叠、草稿保存、引用回复、Vim 模式、Ctrl+Enter 发送和防自动滚动。


## 反馈

有需求或发现 bug，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues) 提交。

## 🚨 GPT-Voyager 1.8.2 — Emergency fix: formula copy

ChatGPT recently changed how it renders math (it no longer emits the hidden LaTeX source), which broke **all three formula copy paths at once**:

- clicking a formula did nothing;
- drag-select + Ctrl+C copied the rendered symbols instead of LaTeX;
- ChatGPT's own copy button no longer had its math delimiters repaired.

**All three work again in 1.8.2**, now sharing one recovery path plus a fallback, so copying keeps working even if ChatGPT renames the attribute again.

Also fixed: the "Move to folder" menu item never appearing on current ChatGPT, and the stray purple "folder" word on every row of that dialog (thanks @isolature, #7).


**🧮 Also new**: a "Desmos / calculators" copy format. A Desmos-style input discards the **entire** paste when it meets one command it does not know, and ChatGPT math is full of typesetting-only commands like `displaystyle`, `qquad` and ` oxed{}` (`,` even pastes as a literal comma). The new format strips them so a copied formula pastes straight in. Pick it under "Formula copy format" in the extension popup.

**📦 Get it now** from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases/tag/v1.8.2).

**🏬 Store build**: Chrome / Edge review has been fast lately — usually a few hours rather than the three days it used to take. If you switched to the GitHub build only to avoid the wait and would rather not update by hand, the store build is a fine place to come back to.

## English — common features

- **Folders** — Organize conversations locally in the sidebar with whole-panel and search collapse, expandable folders, `f:` folder-only filtering, manual or recent sorting, drag-and-drop, nested folders, and JSON import/export.
- **Timeline** — One dot per conversation turn on the right. Hover to preview, click to jump, and see new turns appear in real time.
- **Pins and favorites** — Pin exact locations inside long answers or star messages and revisit them across conversations.
- **Response notifications** — Receive a system alert when a reply finishes after switching conversations or browser tabs, then click to return.
- **Long-code collapse** — Collapse and expand long code blocks without affecting short code or Mermaid diagrams.
- **Chat typography** — Adjust chat font size, line height, paragraph spacing, and content width.
- **Conversation export** — Export the full conversation or selected messages as Markdown, JSON, or HTML.
- **Prompt Manager** — Store and search prompts with tags, then copy or insert them into the composer.
- **Input enhancements** — Composer collapse, draft saving, quote reply, Vim mode, Ctrl+Enter sending, and auto-scroll prevention.


## Feedback

Please report requests or bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues).
